title: Build report — one builder's word on one work item
description: What a builder returns for one work item (SPEC §5 build): built, or blocked with the reason. The code is not in here — it is in the worktree, accounted from base by the runner and held to the binding's surface; this is the builder's word on what it did and what it noticed, and the build record embeds it beside the change set. Blocked with a clear reason is a good outcome: a guess built past a gap would be invisible.

status.description: `built`: the item's code and tests are in place as the binding says. `blocked`: something the binding needs is missing, contradicts the design or is a question nobody answered — nothing was guessed; `reason` says what.

summary.description: What was done, in the binding's terms — the interfaces exposed, the tests written by id — or, blocked, what was not.

suggestions.description: What the binding or the design should say and does not, or what the item would need past its surface — noticed and named, never done. Each rides to the PM.

reason.description: Blocked: the one thing that stops the build, quoting the binding or design line it turns on. Built: null.
